title: Hoop Dunk Master
description: Step onto the hardwood, charge your power gauge with perfect timing, and sink swish after swish for blazing arcade basketball streaks.
controls: Press and hold to charge the shot power bar, then release inside the sweet spot to swish the basketball through the hoop.

zh-CN.title: 投篮高手
zh-CN.description: 魔性街机蓄力投篮挑战：按住精准把控力度条、松手拉出完美弧线空心入网，连进触发超高分狂热手感！
zh-CN.controls: 按住屏幕观察右侧力度条蓄力，瞄准最佳区间松手起跳投篮得分。
